Day ninety-two. I'm travelling across India with zero rupees in my pocket. Today, a truck driver told me a story that broke my heart.
I asked for a lift. A truck stopped. He asked, where are you going? I said, wherever you're going.
We talked for hours. Then suddenly, he went quiet. He said, I haven't been home in fifteen years.
I asked him why. And what he told me... happens in so many of our homes.
His father put his whole life's savings into a fake investment scheme. They promised to double the money. Then one day, the company just vanished.
There was a huge fight at home. His father shouted, this is your fault. Angry, at fifteen, he ran away. He still remembers his mother crying.
I told him, lost money can be earned back. But how many more years can your mother wait? The truck changed direction.
Fifteen years later, at his front door. His mother ran and hugged him. His father cried and said sorry. Lost money comes back. A lost family doesn't.
Never trust any scheme that promises to double your money. Send this to your parents. And follow money in cloud.
